```{r}


packages <- c(
  "tidyverse",
  "broom",
  "epiR",
  "Hmisc",
  "lmtest",
  "multcomp",
  "pROC",
  "rstatix",
  "sandwich",
  "TrialSize",
  "yardstick",
  "FactoMineR",
  "factoextra",
  "ggbiplot",
  "ggdag",
  "corrplot",
  "GGally",
  "ggExtra",
  "ggfortify",
  "ggpubr",
  "pheatmap",
  "plotly",
  "flextable",
  "openxlsx",
  "gtsummary",
  "devtools",
  "knitr"
)

result <- data.frame(
  package = packages,
  installed = sapply(packages, requireNamespace, quietly = TRUE)
)

result
```
